data.text: Yes, I’ll keep my catch to 10 tons and report it honestly. Kate’s recovery point makes sense: if we start below 100 tons, let’s split only what we can catch while leaving 50; if there are 50 tons or fewer, we should pause fishing to let the stock rebuild. My family taught me to protect what feeds the village. Sounds like we’re agreed for this month—let’s check the stock and our catch reports together before next month’s fishing.
